postData.fullText:
AI agents are showing up inside real business software now.
That's the easy part.

The hard part is this: a lot of companies are still getting nothing from AI because the foundation is weak.

If your lead pipeline is inconsistent, automation won't save it.
It will just move the confusion faster.

Here's the order that works:

1) Capture every lead the same way
2) Follow up fast and consistently
3) Make booking simple
4) Track the stage so you can improve conversion

Most teams don't need more tools.
They need a clean system that works when they're busy.

If you want, I'll map your pipeline in 15 minutes and show you the first leak I'd fix.

#operations #salesprocess #crm #automation #servicebusiness
